about_the_game:
You are an ordinary blacksmith in an extraordinary world. While heroes fight monsters, it’s you who forges their weapons.

  • Craft weapons with dozens of unique combinations: from blood tempering to engravings of ancient runes and inlays of magical stones.
  • Match combinations against monsters’ weaknesses and equip heroes with what will help them survive… or not.
  • Trade with local merchants.
  • Improve your reputation so that wealthier characters will come to you.
  • Upgrade your forge, unlocking new stations and recipes.

The lives of heroes — and the entire kingdom — depend on your choices!
